name: Etisalat Modular Data Center - IPTV - Tawi Al Saman (CATV)
notes: Uptime Institute lists the Etisalat Modular Data Center - IPTV - Tawi Al Saman (CATV) in Al Dhaid with Tier III Certification of Design Documents and Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility; Bin Fardan also lists an Etisalat Al Dhaid site in Sharjah among its projects.

name: Khazna Sharjah / COMTECH Freezone Kalba Tier 3 data center
developer: Khazna Sharjah JV (BEEAH Group and Khazna Data Centers), with SCTA
notes: Khazna announced the SCTA/BEEAH/Khazna collaboration for Tier 3 data centers in Sharjah, starting with the emirate's largest facility in Kalba within COMTECH Freezone; BEEAH's earlier JV announcement stated the inaugural Sharjah Tier 3 data center would have 9 MW capacity.

name: Etisalat Kalba data center / SmartHub Kalba
notes: Baxtel lists Etisalat Kalba as a fully operational facility and notes an exterior image for the Kalba facility that was to be delivered in Q1 2022; GCC Business News reported in 2021 that Etisalat opened SmartHub Kalba as its third SmartHub location with a Tier 3 data center facility.

name: XDS Sharjah 1MW immersion-cooled data center
notes: DCD reported XDS inaugurated a 1 MW immersion-cooled colocation facility at Sharjah Research Technology and Innovation Park, intended for immediate AI workloads and as validation for larger multi-megawatt deployments.

name: SCTA DataCanvas International and AI Caravan data center initiative
developer: Sharjah Communications Technology Authority, DataCanvas International and AI Caravan
notes: Sharjah Government Media Bureau and trade coverage describe a tripartite MoU to explore establishing and operating data centers and AI infrastructure projects in Sharjah; no capacity, site, or construction schedule was disclosed.

name: Al Hathboor Bikal.ai Sharjah HPC data center listing
notes: DCD noted Data Center Map lists one Sharjah city facility from product development company Al Hathboor Bikal.ai offering HPC services using Lenovo hardware; public details are sparse, so capacity and exact operational profile remain unverified.
